montecarlo_near_zero_scores.note: Granite-4.2 L4/L6 have near-zero scores (|s| ~ 1e-9). Before the 2026-10-11 fix, theory3_s1h5._log_sinhc lost every digit there, and Theorem M reported a spurious key term: the grid predicted p90 RMS / FP8 1.50 / 1.44 at 6/6 and 1.44 / 1.27 at 8/8, and called both layers unmet. With the fix (these records; 200 dither draws per configuration) measured / predicted MSE is 0.99-1.00 and both layers meet FP8's per-head error at 6/6 and at 4/8.
